mapper.sql: b.id, b.model_code, b.protocol, b.api_path, b.request_adapter, b.usage_extractor, b.stream_usage_extractor, b.status, b.remark, m.id AS model_id, m.provider_account_code
mapper.select: select from kb_model_api_bindings b inner join kb_models m on b.model_code = m.model_code and m.is_deleted = 0 where b.id = #{id}
select from kb_model_api_bindings b inner join kb_models m on b.model_code = m.model_code and m.is_deleted = 0 where m.id = #{modelId} order by b.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_model_api_bindings(model_code, protocol, api_path, request_adapter, usage_extractor, stream_usage_extractor, status, remark) values(#{modelCode}, #{protocol}, #{apiPath}, #{requestAdapter}, #{usageExtractor}, #{streamUsageExtractor}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update kb_model_api_bindings set protocol = #{protocol}, api_path = #{apiPath}, request_adapter = #{requestAdapter}, usage_extractor = #{usageExtractor}, stream_usage_extractor = #{streamUsageExtractor}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete b from kb_model_api_bindings b inner join kb_models m on b.model_code = m.model_code where m.id = #{modelId}
